in_marathi.name: Lohith
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lohith हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Lohita', meaning 'red' or 'fiery'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is known as Lohita Mohana, symbolizing his red form and his fiery passion.
